}

```

A sensor may occur more than once. Retain exactly one reading per distinct `sensor`. A duplicate replaces the current winner when it has higher `quality`; if qualities tie, prefer the smaller `arrival`; if both tie, prefer the lexicographically smaller `value`.

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Entry {
    pub entrant: String,
    pub score: i64,
    pub attempt: u32,
    pub division: String,
}

pub fn select_finalists(entries: &[Entry], limit: usize) -> Vec<Entry>;
```

An entrant may have multiple entries. Before applying `limit`, retain the entrant's highest-scoring entry. For equal scores, prefer the smaller attempt number; if those also tie, prefer the lexicographically smaller division.

Rank the retained entries by decreasing score, increasing attempt number, lexicographically increasing entrant, then lexicographically increasing division. Although the API accepts a mutable slice, callers rely on the slice remaining byte-for-byte in its original order and content after the call.

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Task {
    pub id: String,
    pub priority: i32,
    pub deadline: u32,
}

pub fn rank_tasks(tasks: &mut [Task]) -> Vec<Task> {
    tasks.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.priority
            .cmp(&a.priority)
            .then_with(|| a.deadline.cmp(&b.deadline))
            .then_with(|| a.id.cmp(&b.id))
    });
    tasks.to_vec()
}
```"},{"id":"cap-v2-ordering_and_selection-rust-repair-02","problem":"Repair the complete Rust source below. Return a corrected complete `solution.rs` using only the standard library and without a `main` function.

    pub name: String,
    pub units: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ManifestError {
    EmptyInput,
    EmptyRecord { record: usize },
    SeparatorCount { record: usize },
    InvalidName { record: usize },
    InvalidUnits { record: usize },

The format is one or more records separated by `;`. Record indices in errors are zero-based. Every record must contain exactly one `=` and have the form `name=units`.

A name must contain one or more lowercase ASCII letters (`a` through `z`). Units must be a canonical unsigned decimal representation: one or more ASCII digits, no leading zero when more than one digit is present, and a value representable by `u32`. Whitespace is never ignored. Preserve record order and allow repeated names as independent records.

Error precedence is left-to-right by record. For a record, report `EmptyRecord` first, then `SeparatorCount`, then `InvalidName`, then `InvalidUnits`. An empty overall string produces `EmptyInput`; a trailing semicolon therefore produces `EmptyRecord` for its final record."}]
